raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_ids are exactly the 27 raw rows with record_version=2, which are corrected versions of existing record_version=1 rows; silver_transactions does not deduplicate, so both versions reach silver and inflate the gold aggregates. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter is the standard versioning rule, though the notes do not explicitly confirm it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC) = 1) r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED';"}}
